__comment: Per-asset prompts for tools/generate_assets_rd.py. Every entry is keyed by FULL repo-relative path — several stems (cadantine, torstol, spider_den, ...) exist as both an item icon and an entity image, and a bare filename key would apply one prompt to both. Value is a prompt string, or an object with any of: prompt, seed, style, size, remove_bg. An override replaces the whole prompt — the kind's suffix is NOT appended. Retro Diffusion's guidance: describe the subject only, never write 'pixel art'. Pin a seed on an asset you like to keep it stable across --force runs.

__comment_jewellery_layers: Layered jewellery (see lib/widgets/jewellery_icon.dart). A bare gold band and a bare gold chain plus six loose cuts; the stone is drawn over the top, so the bases have no setting or bezel of their own. Cuts are colourless grey and white on purpose: the game tints them per gem, so any colour here breaks the tint. Cuts are drawn smaller than an icon because they sit in the setting's socket. Pin a seed per batch once one looks right so all six cuts share a style. After generating, the cuts' near-black outline is lifted to mid grey (edge pixels below 120 brightness raised to 120) so the tinted stone edges in a darker shade of its own colour, like the outline-free gold bases; redo that on any re-roll.
